question: A team on a Team plan wants Claude to work with their shared Slack workspace. Which sequence of steps is correct?
options: A) Confirm the policy allows it; have the owner enable the connector; members authenticate individually; agree what may be shared.
B) Have the owner enable the connector; members authenticate individually; confirm the policy allows it; agree what may be shared.
C) Agree what may be shared; members authenticate individually; have the owner enable the connector; confirm the policy allows it.
D) Members authenticate individually; confirm the policy allows it; agree what may be shared; have the owner enable the connector.
correct_answers: A) Confirm the policy allows it; have the owner enable the connector; members authenticate individually; agree what may be shared.
explanations: Correct. Policy clearance comes first, the owner enables it for the organisation, then individuals connect their own access.
The data source is live before anyone has checked whether policy permits it.
Authentication precedes enablement, and the policy check is left until the end.
Members cannot authenticate to a connector the organisation's owner has not enabled.
